name: run_ratelimit_workloads

test_list.description: Drive fifty same-tick requests through DualLimiter, schedule higher priorities first, and verify the measured admissions and 60-second RPM bound including configured burst.
At a fixed pressure point, verify Background is shed while InteractiveUser remains admissible when both are otherwise within quota.
Apply changing parsed Retry-After floors during a fake-clock storm and record the resulting delay spread; this does not prove fixed-floor anti-herd behavior.

Exhaust weighted TPM with reservations, reconcile actual usage below and above reservations, and verify unused reservation remains conservatively charged while overrun is charged and later admission resumes after clock advance.

Exercise duplicate and contradictory parsed Retry-After durations through the real response API; verify 429 penalties are shared, non-429 responses do not penalize, and unrepresentable durations return a typed error.
Spawn blocked acquire waiters, cancel half, and verify all task handles finish and the remaining waiters complete after capacity advances.
Real-clock admission latency samples produce observed percentiles.

inputs.name: quota
inputs.description: Explicit local RPM, TPM, and burst settings for a deterministic workload.

inputs.name: clock
inputs.description: Monotonic fake clock for deterministic workload scenarios.

inputs.name: events
inputs.description: Scripted admission attempts, response statuses, retry hints, usage reports, and cancellation actions.

output_description: Measured deterministic workload results including admission order, sheds, retry spread, reconciliation outcomes, task drain, and observed latency samples.
